Ninjas in Pyjamas (often abbreviated to NIP and NiP) is a Swedish esports organization founded in 2000. The team competed in Counter-Strike until their dissolution in 2002. The team returned a first time in 2005 before being dissolved in 2007. In 2012, the team returned again, this time with a now heavily renowned Counter-Strike: Global Offensive squad, which went on a record-breaking 87-0 map win streak. The longstanding duo of Christopher "GeT_RiGhT" Alesund and Patrik "f0rest" Lindberg, who were a core part of the initial team, departed from the organization after the end of the StarLadder Berlin Major.

Trivia

[edit]
  • Was a founding member of G7 Teams, a now defunct association of professional esports teams. [160]
  • Hold the record for the most finals played and most consecutive finals played at CS:GO Majors with 5, doing so at DreamHack Winter 2013, EMS One: Katowice 2014, ESL One: Cologne 2014, DreamHack Winter 2014 and ESL One: Katowice 2015.
  • Most Major finals lost at 4.
    • Tied with Natus Vincere and FaZe.
  • Hold the record for the longest map win streak on LAN with 87, doing so from September 2012 to April 2013, when it was broken by Virtus.pro.
  • Are the first organization to win a big CS:GO event with a stand-in, doing so with Maikelele at StarLadder i-League StarSeries Season 2.
  • Has the longest map win streak in CS:GO and CS2 Big Events history with 34, doing so from November 2012 to November 2013, when it was broken by LGB eSports. [161]
  • At times have had unexpected event runs and wins. Such runs have been coined by analyst Duncan "Thorin" Shields and later collectively adopted by the community as "NiP Magic".
  • Have a team song titled "Standing When It All Falls Down" by John De Sohn featuring Roshi. [162]
